title: Contributor
description: An organisation submitting contributions. Never an individual vehicle or person.

licence_ref.description: Licence or qualification, e.g. a national surveying qualification.

scheme.description: Name of the licence or qualification scheme, for example a national surveying qualification.

number.description: Licence or qualification number. Not a person's name.

jurisdiction_ids.description: Jurisdictions the contributor may submit to.

trust_tier.description: 0 unverified, 1 registered, 2 audited, 3 licensed or authority.

public_key_ref.description: Reference to the key used to sign submissions.

_note.description: Free-text note; used to label fictional example data.
